question: Which of the following energy sources remained the dominant contributor to India’s renewable energy growth, accounting for 47% of the total installed renewable energy capacity in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solar Power**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India's renewable energy sector has experienced remarkable growth, and solar power remains the largest contributor, accounting for approximately **47% of the total installed renewable energy capacity in 2024.**
 
• The government has launched ambitious initiatives such as the **National Solar Mission** under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC) to achieve substantial solar capacity targets.
 
• India’s target under the Paris Agreement includes achieving **500 GW of non-fossil fuel energy capacity by 2030**, with solar energy playing a pivotal role.
 
• The country has become one of the world’s largest markets for solar energy, leveraging its geographical advantage of abundant sunlight and implementing large-scale solar parks.
